terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D object-space terms and evidence refs.

referenceCamera.note: Three orthographic-like views constrain the complete exterior. Internal ink, roller and underside geometry remain inferred.

objectClass.notes: Observed across an admitted GPT Image 2 four-view turn-sheet; archived pivots, sockets and paper profiles remain frozen.

reasoning: The broad rounded shell is simple, but front and rear articulated paper systems, inset output cavity, controls, rollers, feet and a purpose-readable paper animation require a complex runtime hierarchy.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Compound articulated assembly with radial repetition and mixed transparency.

detailInventory.note: Every visible or runtime-critical feature maps to an existing named procedural component or runtime rig.

definitionOfDone: The printer matches the three-view silhouette and proportions, preserves the cream/pink material zoning, separates all paper-handling assemblies, and unmistakably prints and ejects a page during the 5.2 second powered cue.

featureGroups.name: Rounded shell proportion
qualityCriteria: Height/width 1.12 and depth/width 0.72 with broad corner radii.

featureGroups.name: Eight-ring bubble wheel
qualityCriteria: Exactly eight rings and eight spokes rotate around a centered front axis.

featureGroups.name: Side liquid reservoir
qualityCriteria: Translucent right-rear tank remains attached from side and back.

featureGroups.name: Rear fan and grille
qualityCriteria: Rotor is visible behind concentric grille geometry and four fasteners.

featureGroups.name: Powered purpose animation
qualityCriteria: Control, wheel and fan rotate while bubbles rise and spread, then exact reset at 5.2 seconds.

antiShallowSpecRules: No flat texture replacement for wheel or grille.

mustMatch: wide rounded cream body and thin top seam
rear leaning paper support with white input sheet
deep pink output cavity and projecting hinged tray
large circular control plus small indicator
rear power inlet and lower pink band
visible paper feed and ejection action

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: render screenshot, side-by-side comparison, AI vision score and feature scores

componentTree.name: Printer Root
componentTree.topologyRationale: Runtime container for the complete appliance hierarchy.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: assembled compact printer with independent enclosure, paper supports, cavity, trays, controls and feed modules

componentTree.name: Rounded Main Enclosure
componentTree.topologyRationale: Rounded rigid molded enclosure with a constant broad footprint and visible panel seam.

componentTree.name: Top Access Lid
componentTree.topologyRationale: Discrete circular front assembly proud of the housing.

componentTree.name: Shell Highlight Band
componentTree.topologyRationale: Independent rounded rectangular translucent tank attached to the right-rear housing.

componentTree.name: Rear Paper Support Pivot
componentTree.topologyRationale: Discrete circular rear ventilation and fan assembly inset into the back panel.

componentTree.name: Rear Pink Paper Support
componentTree.topologyRationale: Thick rigid circular trim ring with a rounded cross section.

componentTree.name: Rear Support Backplate
componentTree.topologyRationale: Thin transparent cover follows the circular working cavity.

componentTree.name: Twin Paper Guides
componentTree.topologyRationale: Rigid radial wheel rotates as one assembly around the front axis.

componentTree.name: Input Paper Sheet
componentTree.topologyRationale: Concentric rigid hub cap on the wheel axis.

componentTree.name: Deep Output Cavity
componentTree.topologyRationale: Independent rounded catch tray overlaps the lower front rim.

componentTree.name: Raised Output Inner Lip
componentTree.topologyRationale: Separate low rounded control on the top surface.

componentTree.name: Paired Feed Rollers
componentTree.topologyRationale: Separate round cap above the translucent reservoir.

componentTree.name: Output Tray Hinge Pivot
componentTree.topologyRationale: Independent rotor turns around the rear-facing axis.

componentTree.name: Projecting Output Tray
componentTree.topologyRationale: Rigid circular grille is physically layered in front of the rotor.

componentTree.name: Tray Front Grip
componentTree.topologyRationale: Four discrete molded feet repeat at the housing corners.

componentTree.name: Five Page Performance Rig
componentTree.topologyRationale: Inferred shallow recessed electrical inlet on the rear-lower housing.

componentTree.name: Five Clean Volumetric A4 Pages
componentTree.topologyRationale: Seven repeated recessed rounded slots interrupt the side panel surface.

componentTree.name: Main Control Pivot
componentTree.topologyRationale: Thin raised/recessed mold split line around the lower housing.

componentTree.name: Layered Round Control
componentTree.topologyRationale: Exactly eight separately named toroidal ring modules repeat radially.

componentTree.name: Small Status Indicator
componentTree.topologyRationale: Eight short rigid bars connect hub to ring roots.

componentTree.name: Rear Power Inlet
componentTree.topologyRationale: Five low-cost curved blade solids repeat around the rear rotor.

componentTree.name: Rear Pink Lower Band
componentTree.topologyRationale: Four concentric interrupted rings and spokes form visible grille geometry.

componentTree.name: Four Feet
componentTree.topologyRationale: Four small round screw heads repeat at the rear panel corners.

componentTree.name: Paper Exit Socket
componentTree.topologyRationale: Small raised/dark index line rides on the control cap.

componentTree.name: Power Cable Socket
componentTree.topologyRationale: Inferred shallow overlap bracket connects the observed tank to the housing.

componentTree.name: Inferred Printhead Carriage
componentTree.topologyRationale: Repeated low-segment transparent spheres are runtime effect geometry emitted from the front wheel.

reviewHistory.summary: blockout accepted against the admitted GPT Image 2 turn-sheet and frozen five-page printer runtime contract.
matched: wide low eight-plane enclosure and faceted upper shoulder
enlarged dark output throat, chunky frame, paired rollers and broad hinged tray
rear input support, single clean input page, twelve-sided control and rear power inlet

mismatches: Initial shell side-face winding rendered the enclosure open; review returned refine-code and the winding was corrected before this accepted evidence.
Runtime remains more restrained than the concept sheet because the archived v1 envelope is authoritative.

featureReviews.notes: Closed eight-plane shell, raised support and open tray remain readable in four complete views.
Throat, rollers, tray and support read as one continuous paper-handling system.
Twenty-three frozen runtime transforms match exactly; five-page performance and exact reset tests pass.
Main, structural and detail outline tiers use stable 0.18 object-space variation.

lodPlan.strategy: hide powered bubbles when inactive and reuse geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Use explicit faceted shell topology, low-segment rollers and controls, shared repeated geometry and no runtime textures.

proceduralStrategy: Lock the low wide enclosure, rear support and tray projection first.
Build enclosure, lid, paper support, cavity, tray, controls and power inlet as named assemblies.
Reuse paired guide, roller and foot geometries.
Animate a visible page from output throat to tray with button press, roller spin and indicator light.
Keep reset allocation-free and exact for repeated catalog playback.
risks: Tray enlargement must not move its hinge or intersect the paper source socket.
Main outlines must not be applied to moving paper volumes.
The five paper effects must never be duplicated by ApplianceSpectacleSystem.
